description: This source file defines the AssetUrlShortcodeProvider class, which implements the IShortcodeProvider interface to generate asset URLs with optional parameters for media processing, used within OrchardCore CMS.

classes.name: AssetUrlShortcodeProvider
classes.description: Provides functionality to evaluate 'asset_url' shortcodes, generating URLs for media assets with optional resizing and formatting parameters.
